counterfactual_missing_items: Thrombocytopenia or platelet count is not described
Schistocytes on blood film are absent; rouleaux/auto-agglutination is present instead
No microangiopathic hemolysis markers such as elevated LDH or low haptoglobin are provided
decisive_items: auto-agglutination with macro-aggregates of red cells up to 100 μm in length and rouleaux
response.rationale: R5 has the most raw support and no raw contradictions, but its TTP label is weak because thrombocytopenia and schistocytes are missing. R2 is next via D-dimer/fibrinogen, yet elevated fibrinogen argues against DIC. R4 is contradicted by negative vasculitic studies; R3 rests only on tumor markers; R1 has no support and is contradicted; C1 is a correlated completion of R5 and discounted.

rejected.why: No raw support; negative procoagulant studies directly contradict antiphospholipid syndrome.
Only elevated tumor markers; no malignancy identified and it does not explain auto-agglutination or echo findings.
MRI findings are nonspecific and directly contradicted by negative vasculitic studies.
Correlated restatement of R5 with an appended modifier; auto-agglutination is not a TTP subtype and should be discounted.
